dataList.content:
This really is... a complete mess of a dance. You know that, right?
真是……跳得一团糟。你也知道吧？

... Sure looks like it.
……看起来确实如此。

We'll never stop longing for each other.
我们一辈子都会想念彼此吧。

It'll be hard without each other.
没了彼此的我们，很难忍耐下去的……

And without each other, every moment we live will be pain.
此后也会在无以复加的痛苦中生活下去吧。
After you leave me, and after time passes... Some of these days, you'll miss me. 离开我之后……你总有一天会想念我的。

But that too, I will endure.
但那也同样，是我需要去承受的。

Jeanne, do you still feel... the nausea?
让娜，此时此刻……你还觉得恶心吗？

... No, it's gone. Why is that?
……不，它消失啦。为什么呢？

Because we infused beats and rhythm into what is ultimately meaningless...
或许是因为我们为无意义的事物设下了节拍，赋予了旋律……

... and decided to enjoy this sensation that will soon come to an end. That is why.
并对这即将消逝的感觉……乐在其中吧。
